# The import edges between the packages of the backend: the files that are not tests, whatever
# their build constraints (TestImportEdges, edges_test.go). A line is "from -> to", the directories
# of the packages under src/backend ("." is the root package podkop), and a note after "#".
#
# A new edge fails the test, and so does a line whose edge the sources no longer have: the commit
# that adds or removes an edge changes this list. go test -run TestImportEdges -update . writes it
# anew, with the notes of the edges that stay.
#
# "known:" marks a layering problem already found (the workspace's
# notes/2026-11-23-ux-refactor/backend.md, section 1.2), to be struck by the commit that removes
# the edge; "noted:" an edge that section names as cutting across the layers, a smaller one.

api -> btstats              # noted: the types of the socket hold the report of the statistics (api.go)
api -> logbuf
api -> subscription         # the types of the socket hold those of the subscriptions (api.go): what a provider told, how a list changed
btstats -> dataplane
btstats -> model            # noted: how api reaches model (with api -> btstats)
clock -> dataplane
clock -> uci
cmd/podkop -> .
cmd/podkop -> api
cmd/podkop -> btstats
cmd/podkop -> clock
cmd/podkop -> ctl
cmd/podkop -> dataplane
cmd/podkop -> detect
cmd/podkop -> diag
cmd/podkop -> dnsmasq
cmd/podkop -> engine
cmd/podkop -> engine/bittorrent
cmd/podkop -> firewall
cmd/podkop -> logbuf
cmd/podkop -> migrate
cmd/podkop -> model
cmd/podkop -> netcfg
cmd/podkop -> plan
cmd/podkop -> probe
cmd/podkop -> render
cmd/podkop -> subscription
cmd/podkop -> supervisor
cmd/podkop -> ubus
cmd/podkop -> uci
cmd/podkop -> yacd
ctl -> api
ctl -> btstats
ctl -> clock
ctl -> dataplane
ctl -> diag
ctl -> engine
ctl -> firewall             # noted: a command reaches the kernel itself besides asking the daemon (ctl/device.go)
ctl -> model
ctl -> netcfg               # noted: commands reach the kernel themselves (ctl/global.go, interfaces.go, mtu.go)
ctl -> plan
ctl -> probe
ctl -> sockets
ctl -> subscription
ctl -> ubus
ctl -> uci
ctl -> yacd
diag -> dataplane
diag -> dnsmasq
diag -> firewall            # noted: the checks reach the kernel themselves (diag/checks.go, trace.go)
diag -> model
diag -> netcfg              # noted: the checks reach the kernel themselves (diag/router.go)
diag -> plan
diag -> probe
diag -> sockets
diag -> subscription
diag -> uci
dnsmasq -> dataplane
dnsmasq -> uci
engine -> detect
engine -> engine/bittorrent
firewall -> dataplane
lists -> engine             # noted: a small helper above the adapter of sing-box (lists/derive.go)
lists -> firewall           # noted: a small helper above the adapter of nftables (lists/derive.go)
migrate -> uci
model -> dataplane
model -> migrate
model -> uci
netcfg -> dataplane
netcfg -> uci
plan -> dataplane
plan -> model
plan -> serverid
probe -> engine             # noted: a small helper above the adapter of sing-box (probe/probe.go)
render -> engine
render -> model
render -> plan
render -> uci
subscription -> dataplane
subscription -> serverid
supervisor -> api
supervisor -> btstats
supervisor -> clock
supervisor -> dataplane
supervisor -> detect
supervisor -> dnsmasq
supervisor -> engine
supervisor -> firewall
supervisor -> lists
supervisor -> migrate
supervisor -> model
supervisor -> netcfg
supervisor -> plan
supervisor -> probe
supervisor -> render
supervisor -> sockets
supervisor -> subscription
supervisor -> uci
supervisor -> yacd
yacd -> dataplane
